scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays correctly with headline, subheadline, and primary CTA elements as specified in REQ-1

steps.description: Open the application root URL (/) in a browser
steps.context: User arrives at the landing page as a new visitor

steps.description: Check that the hero section contains a compelling headline, supporting subheadline, and visible CTA buttons
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm presence of primary CTA ('Get Started Free' or similar) and secondary CTA ('Sign In')
steps.context: CTAs should be prominently displayed and clickable

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for hero section elements
test_cases.expected: Hero section renders with headline containing value proposition text

test_cases.input: Query for primary CTA button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Primary CTA button exists with text like 'Get Started Free' or 'Create Your First Short Link'

test_cases.input: Query for secondary CTA button in hero section
test_cases.expected: Secondary CTA button exists with text 'Sign In' for existing users

test_cases.input: Check hero section subheadline content
test_cases.expected: Subheadline text summarizes key features (URL shortening, analytics)

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section displays key product features with icons and descriptions as specified in REQ-2

steps.description: Open the application root URL and scroll to features section
steps.context: Features section should be visible after scrolling past hero

steps.description: Check that 3-4 feature cards are displayed with icons, titles, and descriptions
steps.context: Features should highlight URL shortening, analytics, sharing, and dashboard

steps.description: Validate that each feature card contains meaningful content describing the capability
steps.context: Content should match PRD specifications for each feature

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for features section
test_cases.expected: Features section exists with at least 3 feature cards

test_cases.input: Query for URL Shortening feature card
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title 'URL Shortening' and description about creating short links exists

test_cases.input: Query for Click Analytics feature card
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title 'Click Analytics' and description about tracking clicks exists

test_cases.input: Query for Share Stats feature card
test_cases.expected: Feature card with title 'Share Stats' and description about public share links exists

test_cases.input: Check feature cards have icons
test_cases.expected: Each feature card displays an icon or visual indicator

scenarios.name: Navigation to Login and Register
scenarios.description: Verify clear navigation paths to Login and Register pages as specified in REQ-3

steps.description: Open the application root URL
steps.context: User is on the landing page as a non-authenticated visitor

steps.description: Click on the Login link/button in the navigation or hero section
steps.context: Navigation should be accessible from navbar and/or hero CTAs

steps.description: Confirm user is redirected to /login route
steps.context: Login page should load correctly

steps.description: Return to landing page and click Register link/button
steps.context: Register link should be visible and accessible

steps.description: Confirm user is redirected to /register route
steps.context: Register page should load correctly

test_cases.input: Render Home component with router and click Login link
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /login route

test_cases.input: Render Home component with router and click Register link
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /register route

test_cases.input: Click primary CTA 'Get Started Free' button
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /register route for new user signup

test_cases.input: Click secondary CTA 'Sign In' button in hero
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /login route

test_cases.input: Query navbar for Login and Register links
test_cases.expected: Both Login and Register links are present in the navigation bar

scenarios.name: Responsive Design
scenarios.description: Verify the landing page renders correctly across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports as specified in REQ-7

steps.description: Resize viewport to mobile dimensions and verify layout
steps.context: Content should stack vertically, text should be readable

steps.description: Resize viewport to tablet dimensions and verify layout
steps.context: Layout may be hybrid between mobile and desktop

steps.description: Resize viewport to desktop dimensions and verify layout
steps.context: Full desktop layout with multi-column features

steps.description: Check that no horizontal scrollbar appears at any viewport size
steps.context: Content should fit within viewport width

test_cases.input: Render Home component at 375px width (mobile)
test_cases.expected: All content visible without horizontal scroll, feature cards stack vertically

test_cases.input: Render Home component at 768px width (tablet)
test_cases.expected: Layout adapts appropriately, feature cards may show 2 per row

test_cases.input: Render Home component at 1280px width (desktop)
test_cases.expected: Full desktop layout with feature cards in row, all sections visible

test_cases.input: Check for responsive Tailwind classes
test_cases.expected: Components use responsive breakpoint classes (sm:, md:, lg:)

test_cases.input: Verify navigation is accessible on mobile
test_cases.expected: Navigation menu is accessible via hamburger menu or similar on mobile

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the landing page meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards as specified in NFR-3 and NFR-5

steps.description: Navigate through all interactive elements using Tab key
steps.context: All interactive elements should be reachable and have visible focus states

steps.description: Verify semantic HTML structure and ARIA labels
steps.context: Page should use semantic elements (header, main, section, footer)

steps.description: Verify text color contrast meets 4.5:1 ratio for normal text
steps.context: All text should be readable against background colors

steps.description: Enable prefers-reduced-motion and verify animations are disabled
steps.context: Users with motion sensitivity should see static content

steps.description: Check that all images have descriptive alt attributes
steps.context: Screen readers should be able to describe all visual content

test_cases.input: Query for semantic HTML structure
test_cases.expected: Page uses <header>, <main>, <section>, and <footer> elements appropriately

test_cases.input: Tab through all interactive elements
test_cases.expected: All buttons and links receive focus in logical order with visible focus indicator

test_cases.input: Query all images for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All elements have non-empty alt attributes or role='presentation'

test_cases.input: Test with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
test_cases.expected: Animations and transitions are disabled or reduced

test_cases.input: Verify heading hierarchy
test_cases.expected: Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 -> h2 -> h3) without skipping levels

test_cases.input: Check button accessibility
test_cases.expected: All buttons have accessible names (text content or aria-label)

test_cases.input: Check link accessibility
test_cases.expected: All links have descriptive text (no 'click here' or empty links)
